mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND in_shared_pool = 0) AS customerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clue WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND in_shared_pool = 0 AND (transition_type IS NULL OR transition_type != 'CUSTOMER')) AS clueCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opportunity WHERE organization_id = #{orgId}) AS opportunityCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE organization_id = #{orgId}) AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '')) AS contractCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '')) AS totalContractAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) FROM contract_payment_record WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND verification_status = 'DONE') AS verifiedAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND in_shared_pool = 0 AND create_time >= #{monthStart}) AS monthNewCustomer, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clue WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND in_shared_pool = 0 AND (transition_type IS NULL OR transition_type != 'CUSTOMER') AND create_time >= #{monthStart}) AS monthNewClue

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') AND start_time >= #{sinceMillis} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(record_end_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) AS amount FROM contract_payment_record WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND verification_status = 'DONE' AND record_end_time >= #{sinceMillis} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(record_end_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT t.owner AS owner, t.contractAmount AS contractAmount, t.contractCount AS contractCount, COALESCE(p.verifiedAmount, 0) AS verifiedAmount, COALESCE(c.customerCount, 0) AS customerCount FROM ( SELECT owner, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS contractAmount, COUNT(*) AS contractCount FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') GROUP BY owner ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner, COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM contract_payment_record WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND verification_status = 'DONE' GROUP BY owner ) p ON p.owner = t.owner LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner, COUNT(*) AS customerCount FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND in_shared_pool = 0 GROUP BY owner ) c ON c.owner = t.owner ORDER BY t.contractAmount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.stage AS code, COALESCE(s.name, c.stage) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM contract c LEFT JOIN contract_stage_config s ON s.id = c.stage AND s.organization_id = c.organization_id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND (c.void_reason IS NULL OR c.void_reason = '') GROUP BY c.stage, s.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CONCAT(LEFT(cf.field_value, 2), '0000') AS code, COUNT(*) AS value FROM customer_field cf JOIN sys_module_field f ON f.id = cf.field_id AND f.internal_key = 'customerArea' JOIN sys_module_form m ON m.id = f.form_id AND m.form_key = 'customer' AND m.organization_id = #{orgId} WHERE cf.field_value IS NOT NULL AND cf.field_value != '' GROUP BY CONCAT(LEFT(cf.field_value, 2), '0000') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND owner = #{ownerId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') AND start_time >= #{sinceMillis} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(start_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(record_end_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) AS amount FROM contract_payment_record WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND owner = #{ownerId} AND verification_status = 'DONE' AND record_end_time >= #{sinceMillis} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(record_end_time / 1000), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT c.stage AS code, COALESCE(s.name, c.stage) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM contract c LEFT JOIN contract_stage_config s ON s.id = c.stage AND s.organization_id = c.organization_id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.owner = #{ownerId} AND (c.void_reason IS NULL OR c.void_reason = '') GROUP BY c.stage, s.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS name, c.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(t.contractAmount, 0) AS contractAmount, COALESCE(t.verifiedAmount, 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ct.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(ct.amount), 0) AS contractAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pv.verified), 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM contract ct LEFT JOIN ( SELECT contract_id, COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) AS verified FROM contract_payment_record WHERE verification_status = 'DONE' AND organization_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY contract_id ) pv ON pv.contract_id = ct.id WHERE ct.organization_id = #{orgId} AND ct.owner = #{ownerId} AND (ct.void_reason IS NULL OR ct.void_reason = '') GROUP BY ct.customer_id ) t ON t.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.owner = #{ownerId} AND c.in_shared_pool = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () rc) AS customerCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') AND customer_id IN ()) AS contractAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') AND customer_id IN ()) AS contractCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.record_amount), 0) FROM contract_payment_record p JOIN contract t ON t.id = p.contract_id AND t.organization_id = #{orgId} WHERE p.organization_id = #{orgId} AND p.verification_status = 'DONE' AND t.customer_id IN ()) AS verifiedAmount

SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS name, c.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(t.contractAmount, 0) AS contractAmount, COALESCE(t.verifiedAmount, 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ct.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(ct.amount), 0) AS contractAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pv.verified), 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM contract ct LEFT JOIN ( SELECT contract_id, COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) AS verified FROM contract_payment_record WHERE verification_status = 'DONE' AND organization_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY contract_id ) pv ON pv.contract_id = ct.id WHERE ct.organization_id = #{orgId} AND (ct.void_reason IS NULL OR ct.void_reason = '') GROUP BY ct.customer_id ) t ON t.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.id IN () ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT c.owner AS owner, COALESCE(t.contractAmount, 0) AS contractAmount, COALESCE(t.contractCount, 0) AS contractCount, COALESCE(p.verifiedAmount, 0) AS verifiedAmount, c.customerCount AS customerCount FROM ( SELECT owner, COUNT(*) AS customerCount FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND in_shared_pool = 0 AND owner IS NOT NULL AND owner != '' AND id IN () GROUP BY owner ) c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS contractAmount, COUNT(*) AS contractCount FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') AND customer_id IN () GROUP BY owner ) t ON t.owner = c.owner LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p2.owner, COALESCE(SUM(p2.record_amount), 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM contract_payment_record p2 JOIN contract ct2 ON ct2.id = p2.contract_id AND ct2.organization_id = #{orgId} WHERE p2.organization_id = #{orgId} AND p2.verification_status = 'DONE' AND ct2.customer_id IN () GROUP BY p2.owner ) p ON p.owner = c.owner ORDER BY contractAmount DESC, customerCount DESC

SELECT c.id AS contractId, c.number AS contractNumber, c.customer_id AS customerId, cust.name AS customerName, c.amount AS amount, c.owner AS owner, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.start_time / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') AS signDate, COALESCE(p.verifiedAmount, 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM contract c LEFT JOIN customer cust ON cust.id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT contract_id, COALESCE(SUM(record_amount), 0) AS verifiedAmount FROM contract_payment_record WHERE verification_status = 'DONE' AND organization_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY contract_id ) p ON p.contract_id = c.id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.stage = #{stage} AND (c.void_reason IS NULL OR c.void_reason = '') ORDER BY c.start_time DESC
SELECT name FROM contract_stage_config WHERE id = #{stage} AND organization_id = #{orgId} LIMIT 1
